summary: TRACK 15.75D Platform Trust Validator — backend fully GREEN (37/37 tests pass, live 401/200 contract confirmed). ui_bugs.issue: Card renders the [data-testid='platform-trust-error'] fallback with 'Trust validator unavailable: Not Found' on /admin/email when signed in as super-admin jaymn.judd@mascigc.com. The api.get('/api/admin/platform-trust/validate') call returns 404 from the SPA's perspective even though the same URL returns 200 via curl with the X-Admin-Token from POST /api/auth/multi-login. Likely cause: the shared `api` http client used by the component is not attaching X-Admin-Token (or attaches the wrong token header, or rewrites the path). None of: platform-trust-loading, trust-card-system, trust-card-routing, trust-card-audit, trust-card-pm-coverage, trust-card-workflows, trust-card-dead-letter, platform-trust-run render.

integration_issues.flow: Admin -> Email & Routing -> Platform Trust Validator card
integration_issues.issue: Frontend api client returns 404 for /api/admin/platform-trust/validate while curl with X-Admin-Token (portal_tokens.admin from /api/auth/multi-login) returns 200 with full payload (final_band, 7 workflow rows, audit_status_integrity, pm_email_coverage, etc.). Suggests the api helper used by PlatformTrustValidator.jsx is not attaching the admin token header. Inspect line 93 of PlatformTrustValidator.jsx and the `api` import (likely /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js or similar) — confirm it injects X-Admin-Token from localStorage('masci.admin.token').

action_items: Fix the api client used in /app/frontend/src/components/PlatformTrustValidator.jsx so that GET /api/admin/platform-trust/validate sends X-Admin-Token (mirror what AdminEmail.jsx itself uses to fetch routing-status — those calls work, this one doesn't). Likely the component is using a generic axios instance that doesn't have the admin interceptor. Once fixed, re-verify all 7 trust-card testids render and final_band badge is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend route /api/admin/platform-trust/validate is correctly mounted in server.py at line 10822, returns 401 without token and 200 with admin portal token from multi-login — backend contract is solid.

Frontend PlatformTrustValidator uses an `api` helper for the call (line 93) but evidently it isn't the same helper that AdminEmail's other panels use (routing-status panel renders fine in same page). Recommend reusing the existing fetch helper that AdminEmail.jsx already uses for /api/admin/email-routing-v2/* (which works) — that helper injects the admin token correctly.

Live final_band is 'red' due to one workflow with silent_missing_audit (auto_email_dispatch:meeting). This is a TRUE positive — preview has a meeting row in source collection but no audit row in last 24h. Not a bug, the validator is doing exactly what it was designed to do.

rca of the issue: Backend: solid. Frontend: PlatformTrustValidator.jsx calls api.get() which returns 404 from the SPA's perspective. curl with the same admin token returns 200. Hypothesis: the imported `api` instance does not attach X-Admin-Token (vs the rest of AdminEmail.jsx which fetches admin endpoints successfully). Reproduction: sign in at /admin/login as jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123!, navigate to /admin/email, observe red error block reading 'Trust validator unavailable: Not Found' at top of page. Mitigation: align the api helper to the one used by the working routing-status panel in the same file (or explicitly inject the X-Admin-Token header from localStorage 'masci.admin.token').
